title: 论证逻辑与衔接过渡
desc: 覆盖大作文从引入观点、分析原因到收束建议的全部逻辑衔接句式与过渡表达。

entries.example: It is widely acknowledged that diligence plays a decisive role in academic success.
entries.exampleZh: 人们普遍认为，勤奋在学业成功中起着决定性作用。
entries.note: 首段引出普遍观点的万能句，acknowledged 可换 recognized，后面必须接完整句子。

entries.en: There is a growing awareness that ___
entries.example: There is a growing awareness that regular exercise contributes to both physical and mental well-being.
entries.exampleZh: 人们日益意识到，规律锻炼有益于身心健康。
entries.note: 用于首段引入社会共识，后接完整从句，可替换 growing 为 increasing。

entries.example: Recent years have witnessed a sharp rise in the number of students pursuing overseas education.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来，出国留学的学生数量急剧上升。
entries.note: 图表作文首段描述趋势，宾语多为 rise/decline 等变化类名词，时态用现在完成时。

entries.en: In contemporary society, ___ has become a matter of public concern.
entries.zh: 在当今社会，……已成为公众关注的问题。
entries.example: In contemporary society, the widening gap between urban and rural education has become a matter of public concern.
entries.exampleZh: 在当今社会，城乡教育差距的扩大已成为公众关注的问题。
entries.note: 图画作文首段点题句，空格处填名词短语，勿填句子，concern 可用 attention 替换。

entries.en: When it comes to ___, opinions vary from person to person.
entries.zh: 谈到……，人们的看法各不相同。
entries.example: When it comes to online learning, opinions vary from person to person.
entries.exampleZh: 谈到在线学习，人们看法各异。
entries.note: 引出有争议的话题，to 后接名词或动名词，不要接完整句子。

entries.en: As is vividly depicted in the picture, ___
entries.zh: 正如图画中生动描绘的那样，……
entries.example: As is vividly depicted in the picture, a young man is absorbed in his smartphone while his parents wait silently.
entries.exampleZh: 正如图画中生动描绘的那样，一个年轻人专注于手机，而父母在一旁默默等待。
entries.note: 图画作文首段画面描述句，depicted 后可换 shown，注意状语从句前用逗号隔开。

entries.example: The declining birth rate has aroused widespread concern among demographers and policymakers.
entries.exampleZh: 出生率下降已引起人口学家和政策制定者的广泛关注。
entries.note: 首段点出现象影响，主语通常是现象，concern 可换 debate 或 attention。

entries.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to several factors.
entries.zh: 这一现象可归因于若干因素。
entries.example: This phenomenon can be attributed to several factors, among which economic pressure ranks first.
entries.exampleZh: 这一现象可归因于若干因素，其中经济压力居于首位。
entries.note: 第二段原因分析段的主题句，后可接定语从句具体展开首要原因。

entries.en: Among the contributing factors, ___ ranks first.
entries.zh: 在诸多促成因素中，……居于首位。
entries.example: Among the contributing factors, the excessive use of electronic devices ranks first.
entries.exampleZh: 在诸多促成因素中，过度使用电子设备居于首位。
entries.note: 承上启下点出首要原因，空格处填名词短语，谓语用单数 ranks。

entries.example: It largely stems from the fact that parents place unrealistic expectations on their children.
entries.exampleZh: 这在很大程度上源于父母对孩子抱有不切实际的期望。
entries.note: 用于原因分析段，后可接 the fact that 从句，主语 it 指代上文现象。

entries.example: Many social conflicts are rooted in the unequal distribution of resources.
entries.exampleZh: 许多社会冲突根源于资源分配的不平等。
entries.note: 表深层原因，常用 be deeply rooted in，主语多为复数名词。

entries.example: Careless driving accounts for a considerable proportion of traffic accidents every year.
entries.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶在每年的交通事故中占相当大的比例。
entries.note: 表占比或成因，主语单数时用 accounts for，勿与 count for 混淆。

entries.example: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has given rise to widespread debate about employment.
entries.exampleZh: 人工智能的迅速发展引发了关于就业的广泛争论。
entries.note: 后接名词或名词短语，不接句子，结果多为中性或消极，时态随语境变化。

entries.example: Excessive pressure from examinations can trigger anxiety and even depression among adolescents.
entries.exampleZh: 考试带来的过度压力会引发青少年的焦虑甚至抑郁。
entries.note: 及物动词，后直接接名词，语气强于 cause，多用于消极后果。

entries.zh: 产生，引起（某种情绪或局面）
entries.example: Mutual trust engenders cooperation, whereas suspicion breeds conflict.
entries.exampleZh: 相互信任催生合作，而猜疑滋生冲突。
entries.note: 高级及物动词，后接抽象名词，不加介词，多用于第二段因果论证。

entries.example: A quiet study environment is conducive to deep concentration and sustained intellectual effort.
entries.exampleZh: 安静的学习环境有助于深度专注与持续的智力投入。
entries.note: 后接名词或动名词，不接句子，反义表达为 be detrimental to。

entries.example: Staying up late to play video games is detrimental to both eyesight and academic performance.
entries.exampleZh: 熬夜打电子游戏对视力与学业表现都有害。
entries.note: 常用于危害分析段，后接名词，勿接 that 从句，可替换为 be harmful to。

entries.example: A case in point is the growing number of young people who choose to work from home.
entries.exampleZh: 一个恰当的例子就是越来越多的年轻人选择居家办公。
entries.note: 第二段举例论证，后接名词短语，勿写成 A case in point is that。

entries.example: This is well exemplified by the widespread use of mobile payment in rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 农村地区移动支付的广泛使用就是很好的例证。
entries.note: 被动语态举例句，后接名词短语，多紧跟在原因分析之后。

entries.example: We can take the bicycle-sharing boom as a prime example of green consumption.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以把共享单车的兴起作为绿色消费的典型例子。
entries.note: 结构为 take A as a prime example of B，A 为具体事例，B 为抽象论点。

entries.zh: 历史上此类例子比比皆是。
entries.example: History abounds with such examples, from the Wright brothers to today's space explorers.
entries.exampleZh: 历史上此类例子比比皆是，从莱特兄弟到今天的太空探索者。
entries.note: 可独立成句收束例证，abound 后固定搭配 with，不可换成 in。

entries.example: Admittedly, online courses save time and money; nevertheless, they cannot replace face-to-face interaction.
entries.exampleZh: 诚然，网络课程省时省钱；然而，它们无法取代面对面交流。
entries.note: 让步转折段核心句式，前半句承认对立面，后半句转回自己的主论点。

entries.en: While it is true that ___, it does not follow that ___
entries.zh: 尽管……属实，但这并不意味着……
entries.example: While it is true that technology boosts efficiency, it does not follow that it always improves our lives.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管技术确实提高了效率，但这并不意味着它总能改善我们的生活。
entries.note: 两个空格都须接完整从句，it does not follow that 意为并不能由此推出。

entries.example: Granted that the policy has certain flaws, its overall benefits should not be overlooked.
entries.exampleZh: 就算该政策存在某些缺陷，其总体益处也不应被忽视。
entries.note: 后接完整句子，先承认让步再转折，多用于第二段利弊分析。

entries.zh: 尽管，虽然（后接形容词或副词）
entries.example: The reform has produced tangible results, albeit slowly and unevenly.
entries.exampleZh: 这项改革已产生切实成效，尽管缓慢且不均衡。
entries.note: 连词，后接形容词、副词或短语，不能接完整句子，语气正式。

entries.example: Notwithstanding these obstacles, the team eventually fulfilled its ambitious goal.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管有这些障碍，团队最终实现了其雄心勃勃的目标。
entries.note: 可作介词接名词，也可置于名词后构成倒装，如 obstacles notwithstanding。

entries.zh: 与之形成鲜明对比的是
entries.example: City dwellers enjoy easy access to libraries; in stark contrast, villagers often have none.
entries.exampleZh: 城市居民享有便利的图书馆资源；相比之下，村民往往一无所有。
entries.note: 表强烈对比，前后须为并列的两类对象，多用在分号后另起分句。

entries.example: Moreover, voluntary work helps students develop a sense of social responsibility.
entries.exampleZh: 此外，志愿工作有助于培养学生的社会责任感。
entries.note: 递进段首词，后加逗号，用于接续第二个并列理由，勿与 therefore 混用。

entries.example: In addition to saving energy, cycling also keeps commuters physically fit.
entries.exampleZh: 除了节省能源，骑行还能让通勤者保持身体健康。
entries.note: 后接名词或动名词，常置句首，不可写成 In addition to do。

entries.example: Reading not merely broadens our horizons but also cultivates our capacity for independent thought.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读不仅拓宽我们的视野，还培养我们独立思考的能力。
entries.note: 并列递进句式，前后两部分语法形式须一致，比 not only 更书面。

entries.en: In light of the above analysis
entries.example: In light of the above analysis, it is reasonable to advocate a balanced approach to online learning.
entries.exampleZh: 基于以上分析，倡导一种均衡的在线学习方式是合理的。
entries.note: 末段开头的过渡短语，后加逗号，承接上文并引出结论。

entries.example: To sum up, the picture reminds us that genuine communication deserves our serious attention.
entries.exampleZh: 总之，这幅图画提醒我们，真正的交流值得我们认真关注。
entries.note: 结论段首短语，后加逗号，比 in a word 正式，同一篇中不宜重复使用。

entries.en: It is safe to conclude that ___
entries.zh: 可以有把握地得出结论：……
entries.example: It is safe to conclude that persistence rather than talent determines one's final achievement.
entries.exampleZh: 可以有把握地得出结论：决定一个人最终成就的是坚持而非天赋。
entries.note: 末段总结句，后接完整从句，语气稳妥，适合图画与图表作文收尾。

entries.example: All things considered, the advantages of remote work outweigh its disadvantages.
entries.exampleZh: 综合来看，远程工作的利大于弊。
entries.note: 独立成分，后加逗号接主句，常用于利弊分析类题目的结论。

entries.en: It is high time that we took concrete measures to ___
entries.zh: 该是我们采取具体措施去做……的时候了。
entries.example: It is high time that we took concrete measures to curb food waste on campus.
entries.exampleZh: 该是我们采取具体措施遏制校园食物浪费的时候了。
entries.note: 建议段核心句型，that 从句谓语须用过去时，measure 常用复数形式。

entries.example: Only by combining individual effort with government regulation can we achieve a low-carbon society.
entries.exampleZh: 只有把个人努力与政府监管结合起来，我们才能建成低碳社会。
entries.note: 部分倒装句，by 后接动名词，主句必须倒装，用于措施段收束。

entries.example: The authorities concerned should enact stricter regulations to penalize illegal waste discharge.
entries.exampleZh: 有关当局应制定更严格的法规，惩处非法排放废弃物的行为。
entries.note: 措施段主语，形容词 concerned 后置，谓语用 should 加动词原形。

entries.example: Campaigns should be launched to raise public awareness of the importance of garbage sorting.
entries.exampleZh: 应发起宣传活动，提高公众对垃圾分类重要性的认识。
entries.note: 措施段高频表达，后接名词或动名词，宾语常用 importance 或 need。

entries.example: Governments ought to enact stricter regulations on the emission of industrial waste water.
entries.exampleZh: 政府应对工业废水的排放制定更严格的法规。
entries.note: 政策层面措施，主语多为 government 等机构，对象用 on 引出。

entries.example: Schools and families should join hands to cultivate a favorable atmosphere for honest behavior.
entries.exampleZh: 学校与家庭应携手为诚信行为营造良好氛围。
entries.note: 措施段收束表达，atmosphere 后用 for 引出所针对的行为或对象。

entries.example: It is persistent effort that turns an ordinary learner into an accomplished master.
entries.exampleZh: 正是持续的努力，把一个普通学习者变成技艺精湛的大师。
entries.note: 强调句型，被强调成分放在 It is 之后，that 后接剩余句子成分。

entries.example: What matters most is not how fast we progress but whether we keep moving forward.
entries.exampleZh: 最重要的不是我们前进得多快，而是我们是否持续向前。
entries.note: 主语从句表强调，后接名词或从句，常用于结尾段立意升华。

entries.example: It is not material wealth but a sense of belonging that makes a family truly warm.
entries.exampleZh: 使一个家庭真正温暖的并非物质财富，而是归属感。
entries.note: 强调不是A而是B，两个空格须为同类结构，多用于论点深化处。

entries.en: Not only does it ___, but it also ___
entries.example: Not only does regular reading enrich our knowledge, but it also refines our character.
entries.exampleZh: 经常阅读不仅丰富我们的知识，而且陶冶我们的品格。
entries.note: 前一分句用助动词倒装，后一分句正常语序，前后时态保持一致。

entries.example: So significant is the role of education that no country can afford to neglect it.
entries.exampleZh: 教育的作用如此重要，以至于任何国家都承担不起忽视它的代价。
entries.note: so 加形容词置于句首引起倒装，that 后接结果从句，用于强调重要性。

entries.example: Never before have we been so dependent on digital devices in daily communication.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从未像现在这样在日常交流中如此依赖数字设备。
entries.note: 否定词提前引起完全倒装，后接过去分词，多用于现象评述段。

entries.en: Were it not for ___, we would ___
entries.example: Were it not for mutual cooperation, we would hardly overcome the difficulties we now face.
entries.exampleZh: 要不是相互合作，我们几乎无法克服当前面对的困难。
entries.note: 虚拟条件句省略 if 的倒装式，for 后接名词，主句用 would 加动词原形。

entries.example: Should the government invest more in rural education, the urban-rural gap would gradually narrow.
entries.exampleZh: 如果政府在农村教育上投入更多，城乡差距将逐渐缩小。
entries.note: 省略 if 的虚拟条件倒装，主句用 would 加动词原形，常用于建议句。

entries.example: Provided that both sides make concessions, the dispute can be settled peacefully.
entries.exampleZh: 只要双方都做出让步，争端就可以和平解决。
entries.note: 连词短语，后接完整句子，可替换为 on condition that 或 as long as。

entries.example: To some extent, the popularity of short videos reflects the impatience of modern life.
entries.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，短视频的流行反映了现代生活的浮躁。
entries.note: 表程度限制，可置句首加逗号或句末，使论断更严谨，避免绝对化。

entries.example: More often than not, students who plan their time wisely outperform those who do not.
entries.exampleZh: 通常情况下，善于规划时间的学生比不善于规划的学生表现更出色。
entries.note: 作状语使用，可替换 frequently 以避免重复，增强语言变化。

entries.example: By and large, the benefits of urbanization outweigh the problems it has brought about.
entries.exampleZh: 总的来说，城市化的益处超过它所带来的问题。
entries.note: 置于句首并加逗号，用于总体评价句，语气比 in general 更地道。

entries.example: Faced with fierce competition in the job market, we should sharpen our professional skills.
entries.exampleZh: 面对就业市场的激烈竞争，我们应当磨砺专业技能。
entries.note: 过去分词短语作状语，其逻辑主语须与主句主语一致，常用于措施段。

entries.example: Given that natural resources are limited, it is urgent that we conserve energy.
entries.exampleZh: 鉴于自然资源有限，我们迫切需要节约能源。
entries.note: 后接完整从句表前提，可置于句首引出背景，后接主句提出主张。

entries.example: Judging from the chart, the number of private cars rose steadily over the past decade.
entries.exampleZh: 从图表来看，过去十年私家车数量稳步上升。
entries.note: 图表作文首段描述数据，from 后接 the chart 或 the figures，不必加主语。
